prompts.name: 地球曙光
prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: a full-bleed background image for a premium Taiwanese enterprise AI presentation website. Generate a 16:9 landscape image, ideally 2048x1152 or higher. Photorealistic cinematic astronomy, sophisticated and understated, extremely clean deep midnight navy/black. This is ONLY a background: NO text, letters, numbers, logos, computers, stages, pedestals, buildings, UI, buttons, labels or watermark. Actual HTML will be overlaid. COMPOSITION SAFETY: The left 52% of the entire image is quiet dark negative space for a large heading and numeric facts, with only a few extremely faint stars. The upper right area x58-92%, y8-38% is also dark and quiet for a company logo. The middle right x53-96%, y43-76% is low-contrast for four product images. Highest detail stays near the far right edge and bottom edge. At least 70% of the whole canvas stays low-detail and dark. Never put a bright star, flare, white cloud or line behind those safe areas. Star field is crisp but very sparse, no noise. Cinematic light naturally guides from outer edges toward the lower-right product stage area without crossing text. All edges meet dark navy cleanly for responsive crops. No grain, no blurry details, no neon oversaturation. SCENE 1 — EARTH DAWN: A realistic large Earth night-side emerging into view from the bottom-right edge, mostly outside frame. Thin atmospheric electric-blue rim sweeps down the right perimeter into the bottom margin. A few restrained amber city lights at the very bottom right, dark blue ocean and delicate cloud textures, no dominant continent in center. Small soft sunrise glow tucked at extreme right edge around y80%. Refined global enterprise, awe, quiet confidence. Strong horizontal negative space left.
